'''Rovessh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], who was a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he went to the [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to hire a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to catch the Guild's ten most wanted criminals, [[Burr El]], [[Ronald Varim]], [[Delia Visi]], [[Vatoono]], [[Kylaena]], [[Oppio Sliveri]], [[TK-577]], [[Mei Lai]], [[Vo'karr Er To]] and [[Rune]]. The bounty hunter returned when he had tracked down and killed them all and Rovessh rewarded him with a Master Crafted [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifle]] and a Master Crafted [[DC-15]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rovessh appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
